title: Machine-learning scores on five blood parameters screen for beta-thalassemia and HbE
summary: Decision trees, Naive Bayes and artificial neural networks were used on five hematological parameters from one Indian institute to build two scoring schemes, one for beta-thalassemia trait and one for joint HbE trait and thalassemia trait. On two validation data sets both scores had 100% sensitivity, with specificity of 79.25% and 91.74% for the trait score and 58.62% and 78.03% for the joint score, and a lower Youden's index than some existing indices. Data come from a single region and the abstract does not give validation set sizes.
ai_technology: Decision trees, Naive Bayes classifier and artificial neural networks on hematological parameters
